{{Quote|I am Teek! I am a tier-six inventor of Research Corps Eight of the Imperial Science Bureau!|Teek|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Teek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] and a twin brother of [[Jeek]].<ref name="Brother" /> Both brothers proudly claimed themselves as tier-six inventors of [[Research Corps Eight]] of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]], a rare feat for non-Humans in the xenophobic Empire. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the two brothers traveled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where stationed at two different Imperial outposts each of them asked the same Imperial passerby to help with testing of new [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="TOR" />
